name.zh: 臺灣經典老車站 6 選

description.zh: 從內灣到菁桐，走過六座留著木造月台與鐵道記憶的車站。
description.en: Six stations that still carry the memory of Taiwan's old rail lines.

name.zh: 古蹟尋跡：六座見證統治者更迭的建築
name.en: Heritage Trail: Six Landmarks, Six Eras

description.zh: 從艋舺老街到金門城樓，六座古蹟見證了荷蘭人、清朝與日本人先後在此留下的痕跡。
description.en: From an old Taipei neighborhood to a Kinmen watchtower — six landmarks spanning the Dutch, Qing, and Japanese eras.

description.zh: 古蹟、車站、圖書館與一碗豆花——臺南是走出來的。
description.en: Forts, a station, a library, and a bowl of tofu pudding — Tainan is best explored on foot.

description.zh: 六座館，六種看世界的方式。
description.en: Six museums, six ways of looking at the world.

description.zh: 威士忌、巧克力、蠟筆與漢餅，六種被做出來的味道。
description.en: Whisky, chocolate, crayons and pastry — six things you can watch being made.

description.zh: 六座圖書館，六個城市最安靜的地方。
description.en: Six libraries — the quietest room in six cities.

description.zh: 從一碗麵線開始，把台灣吃過一遍。
description.en: Start with a bowl of noodles and eat your way across Taiwan.

name.en: 6 Botanical Gardens and Forest Parks Worth the Trip

description.zh: 從碧潭邊的二叭子到瑞穗的樟樹林，六座植物園與森林遊樂區，適合放慢腳步、聞著草木呼吸。
description.en: From a quiet garden by Bitan to a camphor forest in Ruisui — six botanical gardens and forest parks worth slowing down for.

description.zh: 從上野的博物館到淺草寺，再到築地吃一輪，六個地方認識東京。
description.en: From the museum in Ueno to Senso-ji and breakfast at Tsukiji, six places to start with Tokyo.

description.zh: 清水寺、千本鳥居、嵐山竹林與錦市場，京都要慢慢走。
description.en: Kiyomizu-dera, the torii of Fushimi Inari, the Arashiyama bamboo and Nishiki Market: Kyoto is best taken slowly.

description.zh: 大阪城、黑門市場、中之島的美術館和圖書館，再去池田做一杯自己的杯麵。
description.en: Osaka Castle, Kuromon Market, the museum and library on Nakanoshima, then your own Cup Noodles in Ikeda.

name.zh: 北海道：甜點、啤酒與花田

description.zh: 札幌的白色戀人與啤酒博物館、小樽的老車站，夏天再到富良野看薰衣草。
description.en: Shiroi Koibito and the beer museum in Sapporo, Otaru's old station, and Furano's lavender in summer.

description.zh: 從那霸的首里城和市場，一路往北到萬座毛與美麗海水族館。
description.en: From Shuri Castle and the markets of Naha north to Cape Manzamo and the Churaumi Aquarium.

description.zh: 築地、錦市場、黑門市場到牧志公設市場，四座市場邊走邊吃。
description.en: Tsukiji, Nishiki, Kuromon and Makishi: four markets to eat your way through.

description.zh: 從大三巴、議事亭前地到媽閣廟，再去氹仔看葡式老房子，最後在路環吃一顆蛋塔。
description.en: From the Ruins of St. Paul's and Senado Square to A-Ma Temple, then the Taipa Houses and an egg tart in Coloane.

description.zh: 從景福宮走進北村韓屋村，再到舊首爾站、舊市廳和國立中央博物館，看首爾的過去。
description.en: From Gyeongbokgung into the hanok lanes of Bukchon, then the old Seoul Station, the old City Hall and the National Museum of Korea.

description.zh: 東大門設計廣場、星空圖書館、廣藏市場，沿清溪川散步，最後上南山看夜景。
description.en: Dongdaemun Design Plaza, Starfield Library and Gwangjang Market, a walk along Cheonggyecheon, then up Namsan for the view.

description.zh: 從札嘎其市場和甘川洞文化村，到太宗台的斷崖、海雲台的海岸列車和海邊的龍宮寺。
description.en: From Jagalchi Market and Gamcheon Culture Village to the cliffs of Taejongdae, the Haeundae seaside train and the temple by the sea.

description.zh: 城山日出峰看日出、涉地可支走海岬，再到茶園喝綠茶、東門市場吃宵夜。
description.en: Sunrise at Seongsan Ilchulbong, the Seopjikoji headland, green tea among the fields and a late snack at Dongmun Market.

description.zh: 西九的兩座博物館、尖沙咀鐘樓，搭山頂纜車上太平山，晚上逛廟街。
description.en: The two museums in West Kowloon, the Tsim Sha Tsui clock tower, the Peak Tram up to Victoria Peak and Temple Street at night.

name.en: Hong Kong Old Streets and Temples

description.zh: 上環文武廟、結志街的絲襪奶茶、大埔舊車站，再到大嶼山看天壇大佛。
description.en: Man Mo Temple, milk tea on Gage Street, the old Tai Po station and the Big Buddha on Lantau.

description.zh: 從歌劇院、岩石區到皇家植物園，再去維多利亞女王大廈和新的雪梨魚市場。
description.en: From the Opera House and The Rocks to the Royal Botanic Garden, then the QVB and the new Sydney Fish Market.

description.zh: 福林德斯街車站出發，走到州立圖書館、維多利亞女王市場和皇家展覽館。
description.en: Start at Flinders Street Station, then the State Library, Queen Victoria Market and the Royal Exhibition Building.

name.zh: 昆士蘭：布里斯本與凱恩斯

description.zh: 布里斯本的南岸公園、無尾熊和啤酒廠，再到凱恩斯搭觀光火車上庫蘭達。
description.en: South Bank, koalas and a brewery in Brisbane, then the scenic railway up to Kuranda from Cairns.

description.zh: 奧克蘭的博物館、火山丘和魚市場，再去哈比村和羅托魯瓦的地熱谷。
description.en: Auckland's museum, volcano and fish market, then Hobbiton and the geothermal valley at Rotorua.

description.zh: 基督城火車站和植物園，皇后鎮的天空纜車與漢堡，最後到蒂卡波湖畔的小教堂。
description.en: Christchurch's station and gardens, the Skyline and a burger in Queenstown, then the chapel on Lake Tekapo.

description.zh: 戰後重建的老城與皇家城堡、猶太人歷史博物館，再到屋頂花園和美食市集。
description.en: The rebuilt Old Town and Royal Castle, the POLIN museum, a rooftop library garden and a food hall.

description.zh: 中央廣場、聖母聖殿和瓦維爾城堡，猶太區吃烤法棍披薩，再到維利奇卡鹽礦。
description.en: The Main Market Square, St. Mary's and Wawel, zapiekanka in Kazimierz, then the Wieliczka Salt Mine.

description.zh: 大英博物館、國家美術館、倫敦塔和西敏寺，再搭倫敦眼、到邱園散步。
description.en: The British Museum, the National Gallery, the Tower and Westminster Abbey, then the London Eye and a walk in Kew.

description.zh: 大英圖書館和 Daunt Books、波羅市場和哈洛德百貨，從希斯洛機場到聖潘克拉斯車站。
description.en: The British Library and Daunt Books, Borough Market and Harrods, from Heathrow to St Pancras.

description.zh: 城堡、皇家哩大道上的威士忌，最後爬上亞瑟王座看整座城。
description.en: The castle, whisky on the Royal Mile, then up Arthur's Seat for the view.

description.zh: 自由女神、帝國大廈、中央車站和中央公園，再看大都會與自然史博物館。
description.en: The Statue of Liberty, the Empire State Building, Grand Central and Central Park, then the Met and the natural history museum.

description.zh: 公共圖書館的石獅、Strand 書店、雀兒喜市場，晚上到麥迪遜廣場花園看球。
description.en: The library lions, Strand, Chelsea Market, and a game at Madison Square Garden.

description.zh: 金門大橋、渡輪大廈市集、搭船上惡魔島，最後在北灘喝一杯咖啡。
description.en: The Golden Gate Bridge, the Ferry Building, a boat to Alcatraz and a coffee in North Beach.

description.zh: 格里菲斯天文台和蓋蒂中心，再去迪士尼樂園和環球影城。
description.en: Griffith Observatory and the Getty Center, then Disneyland and Universal Studios.

description.zh: 派克市場看魚販拋魚，再上太空針塔。
description.en: Fish-throwing at Pike Place Market, then up the Space Needle.

description.zh: CN 塔、皇家安大略博物館、聖勞倫斯市場和卡薩羅馬城堡，再去看馬蹄瀑布。
description.en: The CN Tower, the ROM, St. Lawrence Market and Casa Loma, then Horseshoe Falls.

description.zh: 史丹利公園的圖騰柱與水族館、格蘭維爾島市場，再走一趟卡皮拉諾吊橋。
description.en: Stanley Park's totem poles and aquarium, Granville Island Market and the Capilano Suspension Bridge.

description.zh: 蒙特婁聖母大教堂的藍色拱頂，和魁北克舊城上的芳堤娜城堡。
description.en: The blue vaults of Notre-Dame in Montréal and the Château Frontenac above Old Québec.

name.zh: 開羅、吉薩與亞歷山大港

description.zh: 金字塔與大埃及博物館、開羅老城的市集和清真寺，再到海邊的亞歷山大圖書館。
description.en: The pyramids and the Grand Egyptian Museum, old Cairo's bazaar and mosque, then the library by the sea in Alexandria.

description.zh: 路克索的卡納克神廟和帝王谷，一路往南到阿布辛貝神殿。
description.en: Karnak and the Valley of the Kings at Luxor, then south to Abu Simbel.

description.zh: 從臺大椰林大道、東大赤門、京大時計台，到港大、延世、雪梨和墨爾本大學。
description.en: From NTU's palm avenue, UTokyo's Red Gate and Kyoto's clock tower to HKU, Yonsei, Sydney and Melbourne.

description.zh: 走上歌劇院的屋頂、看孟克的《吶喊》和維格蘭雕塑公園，再到美食市集吃一輪。
description.en: Walk up the Opera House roof, see Munch and the Vigeland sculptures, then eat at Mathallen.

description.zh: 卑爾根的布呂根木屋和魚市場、搭纜車上弗洛伊恩山，再搭弗洛姆鐵道，最後到北極圈的特羅姆瑟。
description.en: Bergen's Bryggen and fish market, the funicular up Fløyen, the Flåm Railway, then Tromsø above the Arctic Circle.

description.zh: 舊城大廣場、市政廳、瓦薩沉船和斯堪森，喝杯咖啡配肉桂捲，再到哥德堡的遊樂園。
description.en: Gamla Stan, City Hall, the Vasa and Skansen, a coffee and cinnamon bun, then Liseberg in Gothenburg.

description.zh: 白色大教堂、岩石教堂、Oodi 圖書館和老市場大廳，搭渡輪到芬蘭堡，最後在海邊小木屋喝咖啡。
description.en: The white cathedral, the Rock Church, Oodi and the Old Market Hall, a ferry to Suomenlinna and coffee in a seaside cabin.

description.zh: 在羅瓦涅米跨過北極圈、拜訪聖誕老人村，再到北極博物館認識極地。
description.en: Cross the Arctic Circle at Santa Claus Village in Rovaniemi, then learn about the north at Arktikum.

description.zh: 從碼頭走進迪化街，老茶行、廟埕小吃與百年西餐廳都在幾條街內。
description.en: From the riverside wharf into Dihua Street: old tea houses, temple-front snacks and a restaurant that has served since 1934.

description.zh: 從新北投站出發，沿著溫泉溪走過老浴場、地熱谷與森林裡的圖書館。
description.en: From Xinbeitou Station along the hot-spring stream, past an old bathhouse, Thermal Valley and a library in the trees.

description.zh: 臺北最老的街區：龍山寺、剝皮寮、紅樓，再吃一碗麵線。
description.en: Taipei's oldest quarter: Lungshan Temple, Bopiliao and the Red House, with a bowl of noodles on the way.

description.zh: 從眷村到摩天大樓，再爬上象山看一眼台北101。
description.en: From an old military village to the tallest tower, then up Elephant Mountain for the view back at Taipei 101.

description.zh: 紅毛城、小白宮與老教堂，走到漁人碼頭看夕陽。
description.en: Fort San Domingo, the Little White House and an old church, then on to Fisherman's Wharf for sunset.

description.zh: 幾家開了半世紀的咖啡館，加上獨立書店與舊書店，適合慢慢逛一天。
description.en: Cafés that have poured coffee for half a century, plus independent and secondhand bookshops for a slow day.

description.zh: 每天通勤就會經過的轉乘大站，上下班順手蓋一枚。
description.en: The big interchange stations you pass on the daily commute; collect one on the way to work.

name.zh: 博愛特區與中正紀念堂

description.zh: 總統府、博物館與公園，一路走到中正紀念堂的大廣場。
description.en: The Presidential Office, a museum and a park, ending at the great square of the Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall.

description.zh: 大學、老宅、市場和一籠小籠包，最後在大安森林公園休息。
description.en: A university, an old Japanese-era house, a market and a basket of soup dumplings, ending in Da'an Forest Park.

description.zh: 白天看科學館與天文館，傍晚逛官邸花園，晚上吃士林夜市。
description.en: Science museum and planetarium by day, the residence gardens at dusk, then Shilin Night Market.

description.zh: 孔廟與保安宮比鄰而立，再走到花博公園，遠望圓山大飯店。
description.en: The Confucius Temple and Bao'an Temple side by side, then the Expo Park with the Grand Hotel on the hill.

description.zh: 上午逛動物園，下午搭纜車上貓空喝茶，順路到指南宮。
description.en: The zoo in the morning, the gondola up to Maokong's tea houses in the afternoon, with a stop at Zhinan Temple.

description.zh: 碧潭吊橋出發，一路往山裡到烏來的老街、台車與瀑布。
description.en: From the Bitan suspension bridge up into the hills to Wulai's old street, trolley and waterfall.

description.zh: 女王頭、白沙灣與最北端的燈塔，回程在金山吃一碗鴨肉。
description.en: The Queen's Head, Baishawan beach and the northernmost lighthouse, with duck at Jinshan on the way back.

description.zh: 住在臺北的人平常會去的公園、圖書館、市場和書店。
description.en: The parks, libraries, markets and bookshops Taipei people use every week.

description.zh: 林家花園的亭臺樓閣，市民廣場與新圖書館，晚上逛湳雅夜市。
description.en: The pavilions of the Lin Family Garden, the city square and new library, then Nanya Night Market.

description.zh: 陶瓷老街與美術館，再到三峽看祖師廟的精細雕刻。
description.en: The ceramics street and art museum in Yingge, then the finely carved Zushi Temple in Sanxia.

description.zh: 山城老街、老戲院和黃金博物館，回程到十分放天燈。
description.en: A hillside old street, an old theatre and the Gold Museum, with a stop at Shifen on the way back.

description.zh: 老街廟口、大學校園、河濱大公園，再上烘爐地看夜景、喝碗豆漿。
description.en: An old temple street, a campus and a riverside park, then the night view from Hongludi and a bowl of soy milk.

description.zh: 展覽館、流行音樂中心與胡適故居，最後到碧湖散步、搭摩天輪。
description.en: An exhibition hall, the pop music centre and Hu Shih's home, then a lakeside walk and the Ferris wheel.

description.zh: 演唱會、球賽、表演和出發旅行的地方，順路看看清代的北門。
description.en: Where Taipei goes for concerts, ball games and shows, and where trips begin, with the Qing-era North Gate on the way.

description.zh: 從新舊兩座車站出發，沿綠川走到宮原眼科與日治時期的官廳。
description.en: From the old and new stations along the Lüchuan stream to Miyahara and the Japanese-era government halls.

description.zh: 湖心亭、老酒廠與日式宿舍，再到孔廟和寶覺寺，最後在春水堂喝一杯珍奶。
description.en: The lake pavilion, an old winery and Japanese-era houses, the Confucius Temple and Baojue Temple, with a bubble tea where it began.

description.zh: 沿著綠園道走過美術館、科博館與審計新村，晚上到一中街。
description.en: Down the greenway past the art museum, the science museum and Shenji Village, ending on Yizhong Street.

description.zh: 歌劇院、秋紅谷到水湳的中央公園與綠美圖，晚上逛逢甲。
description.en: The Opera House and Calligraphy Lake, the new central park and library in Shuinan, then Fengjia at night.

description.zh: 從美麗島站到駁二與大港橋，沿愛河走到流行音樂中心。
description.en: From Formosa Boulevard Station to Pier-2 and the Dagang Bridge, along the Love River to the Pop Music Center.

description.zh: 老街與萬和宮，往南到林家宮保第和九二一地震教育園區。
description.en: An old street and Wanhe Temple, then south to the Lin family mansion and the 921 Earthquake Museum.

description.zh: 路思義教堂、彩虹眷村，傍晚到高美濕地看夕陽。
description.en: The Luce Chapel and Rainbow Village, then sunset at Gaomei Wetlands.

description.zh: 廟東小吃、自行車綠廊和糖廠冰品，再去麗寶樂園。
description.en: Snacks by Ciji Temple, a bike path on an old railway, sugar-factory ice, then Lihpao Land.

description.zh: 鐵道館、武德殿和英國領事館，搭渡輪到旗津看燈塔。
description.en: The railway museum, the martial arts hall and the British consulate, then the ferry to Cijin's lighthouse.

description.zh: 佛陀紀念館、糖廠、旗山老街與美濃，還有月世界的泥岩地形。
description.en: The Buddha Museum, a sugar factory, Qishan's old street, Meinong and the mudstone hills of Moon World.

description.zh: 龍虎塔、舊城門與美術館，晚上逛瑞豐夜市。
description.en: The Dragon and Tiger Pagodas, an old city gate and the art museum, then Ruifeng Night Market.

description.zh: 三鳳宮與年貨大街、百年老車站，再吃一碗牛肉麵。
description.en: Sanfeng Temple and its market street, a century-old station building and a bowl of beef noodles.

description.zh: 新堀江、中央公園、圖書館總館與港邊的展覽館和夢時代。
description.en: Xinkujiang, Central Park, the main library and the harbourside exhibition hall and Dream Mall.

description.zh: 衛武營的大屋頂、書院與龍山寺，再到澄清湖散步。
description.en: The great roof of Weiwuying, an old academy and Longshan Temple, then a walk around Chengcing Lake.

description.zh: 孔廟、武廟、大天后宮與林百貨，半天走完府城的老中心。
description.en: The Confucius Temple, the Martial Temple, the Grand Matsu Temple and Hayashi, all in one half-day walk.

description.zh: 神農街、水仙宮市場與擔仔麵，晚上挑一個夜市。
description.en: Shennong Street, Shuixian Market and danzai noodles, then pick one of the night markets.

description.zh: 老車站、城隍廟、東門城與公園，市區一個下午走得完。
description.en: The old station, the City God Temple, the East Gate and the park, all in one afternoon.

name.en: Hsinchu Hills, Coast and Old Streets

description.zh: 兩所大學、海邊漁港和濕地，再到北埔與內灣的客家老街。
description.en: Two universities, a fishing harbour and wetland, then the Hakka old streets of Beipu and Neiwan.

description.zh: 老街的木藝與牌樓，再到慈湖和角板山。
description.en: Daxi's woodcraft and arcaded street, then Cihu and Jiaobanshan.

description.zh: 機場、水族館、新圖書館和漁港，出國前後都順路。
description.en: The airport, the aquarium, the new library and the fishing harbours, easy before or after a flight.

description.zh: 古堡、樹屋、億載金城和老街，傍晚到漁光島看海。
description.en: The fort, the Tree House, the Eternal Golden Castle and the old street, then the sea at Yuguang Island.

description.zh: 老車站、成大校園、臺南公園和開元寺，往南到奇美博物館。
description.en: The old station, the NCKU campus, Tainan Park and Kaiyuan Temple, then south to the Chimei Museum.

description.zh: 臺史博、鹽山、瓦盤鹽田與南鯤鯓，一天認識臺南的海邊。
description.en: The history museum, the salt mountain, tile-bed salt fields and Nankunshen Temple along the coast.

description.zh: 糖廠、老街與烏山頭水庫，看看府城以外的臺南。
description.en: Sugar mills, old streets and the Wushantou Reservoir, the Tainan beyond the old city.

description.zh: 林田山、光復糖廠和瑞穗牧場，沿著縱谷一路往南。
description.en: Lintianshan, the Guangfu sugar factory and Ruisui Ranch, heading south down the valley.

description.zh: 文創園區、松園別館與將軍府，晚上吃東大門夜市。
description.en: The creative park, the Pine Garden and the General's Residence, then Dongdamen Night Market.

description.zh: 七星潭的礫石海灘、太魯閣與鯉魚潭，加上海洋公園。
description.en: The pebble beach at Qixingtan, Taroko and Liyu Lake, plus the ocean park.

description.zh: 幾米廣場、老酒廠與美術館，再到礁溪泡腳、頭城老街。
description.en: Jimmy Liao's plaza, an old winery and the art museum, then a foot soak in Jiaoxi and Toucheng's old street.

description.zh: 林業園區、傳藝中心和羅東夜市，往南到蘇澳泡冷泉。
description.en: The forestry park, the traditional arts centre and Luodong Night Market, then cold springs in Su'ao.

description.zh: 從海邊的蘭陽博物館到太平山，中間停在瀑布與威士忌酒廠。
description.en: From the seaside Lanyang Museum up to Taipingshan, with a waterfall and a whisky distillery on the way.

description.zh: 火雞肉飯、舊監獄、美術館和文化路夜市。
description.en: Turkey rice, the old prison, the art museum and Wenhua Road Night Market.

description.zh: 從北門車站與檜意森活村，搭森林鐵路上奮起湖與阿里山。
description.en: From Beimen Station and Hinoki Village up the forest railway to Fenqihu and Alishan.

description.zh: 故宮南院、新港奉天宮與交趾陶，最後到東石看海。
description.en: The Southern Palace Museum, Fengtian Temple and koji pottery, ending by the sea at Dongshi.

description.zh: 沿著山手線一圈，在各大站收集站章，順便看看站外的街區。
description.en: Around the Yamanote loop, one stamp at each major station and a look at the streets outside.

description.zh: 十字路口、明治神宮和竹下通，晚上到新宿的展望台與橫丁。
description.en: The crossing, Meiji Jingu and Takeshita Street, then Shinjuku's free observatory and its old alleys.

description.zh: 上野的博物館與動物園，再走到谷中銀座和根津神社的老街區。
description.en: Ueno's museums and zoo, then the old streets of Yanaka Ginza and Nezu Shrine.

description.zh: 嵐電到嵐山，渡月橋、天龍寺與竹林，再搭小火車。
description.en: The Randen tram to Arashiyama: Togetsukyō, Tenryū-ji and the bamboo grove, then the scenic train.

description.zh: 晴空塔與東京鐵塔，加上淺草寺、日本橋與兩國的相撲。
description.en: Skytree and Tokyo Tower, with Sensō-ji, Nihonbashi and sumo in Ryōgoku.

description.zh: 神保町與代官山的書店，銀座和豐洲，再到六本木的美術館。
description.en: Bookshops in Jimbōchō and Daikanyama, Ginza and Toyosu, then the art museum in Roppongi.

description.zh: 井之頭公園散步，到吉卜力美術館，再去豪德寺看招財貓。
description.en: A walk in Inokashira Park, the Ghibli Museum, then the beckoning cats of Gōtoku-ji.

description.zh: 兩座機場、東京車站與迪士尼，旅程的開頭和結尾。
description.en: Two airports, Tokyo Station and Disneyland, where trips begin and end.

description.zh: 布袋戲的故鄉、還在冒煙的糖廠，再到北港朝天宮和老街。
description.en: The home of glove puppetry and a sugar mill that still runs, then Beigang's Chaotian Temple and old street.

description.zh: 西螺大橋與醬油老街，再到斗六的巴洛克老街和日式宿舍，玩一趟劍湖山。
description.en: The Xiluo Bridge and its soy-sauce street, Douliu's baroque arcades and Japanese-era houses, and a day at Janfusun.

description.zh: 從臺中到花蓮，走訪老糖廠的煙囪、五分車和一支冰棒。
description.en: Old sugar mills from Taichung to Hualien: chimneys, narrow-gauge cane trains and an ice pop at each.

description.zh: 清水寺、二年坂三年坂、八坂神社到祇園，京都最經典的一段路。
description.en: Kiyomizu-dera, Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka, Yasaka Shrine and Gion, Kyoto's classic walk.

description.zh: 金閣寺、龍安寺和北野天滿宮，再到下鴨神社與御所。
description.en: Kinkaku-ji, Ryōan-ji and Kitano Tenmangū, then Shimogamo Shrine and the Imperial Palace.

description.zh: 銀閣寺沿著水渠走到南禪寺，再到平安神宮。
description.en: From Ginkaku-ji along the canal to Nanzen-ji, then on to Heian Shrine.

description.zh: 京都塔、東寺、鐵道博物館與伏見稻荷，最後到宇治喝抹茶。
description.en: Kyoto Tower, Tō-ji, the railway museum and Fushimi Inari, ending with matcha in Uji.

description.zh: 奈良公園的鹿、東大寺大佛與春日大社，再到奈良町和法隆寺。
description.en: The deer of Nara Park, the Great Buddha and Kasuga Taisha, then Naramachi and Hōryū-ji.

description.zh: 道頓堀、心齋橋與黑門市場，再到通天閣和阿倍野。
description.en: Dōtonbori, Shinsaibashi and Kuromon Market, then Tsūtenkaku and Abeno.

description.zh: 梅田的空中庭園、天神橋筋與天滿宮，再到中之島。
description.en: The Umeda Sky Building, Tenjinbashi-suji and Tenmangū, then Nakanoshima.

description.zh: 環球影城、海遊館與萬博公園的太陽之塔。
description.en: Universal Studios, the Kaiyukan aquarium and the Tower of the Sun in Expo Park.

description.zh: 港塔、異人館與南京町，再到姬路看白鷺城。
description.en: The port tower, the foreign residences and Nankinmachi, then Himeji's white castle.

description.zh: 博多站、櫛田神社和運河城，晚上到中洲吃屋台、一蘭。
description.en: Hakata Station, Kushida Shrine and Canal City, then yatai stalls and ramen in Nakasu.

description.zh: 城跡與大濠公園，再到海邊的福岡塔與巨蛋。
description.en: The castle ruins and Ōhori Park, then Fukuoka Tower and the dome by the sea.

description.zh: 太宰府、柳川遊船、門司港和糸島的夫婦岩。
description.en: Dazaifu, a punt in Yanagawa, Mojikō and the wedded rocks of Itoshima.

description.zh: 朝市、紅磚倉庫、八幡坂與五稜郭，晚上上函館山看夜景。
description.en: The morning market, the red-brick warehouses, Hachiman-zaka and Goryōkaku, then the night view from Mt Hakodate.

description.zh: 薰衣草田、青池和森林精靈露台，再到旭山動物園。
description.en: Lavender fields, the Blue Pond and Ningle Terrace, then Asahiyama Zoo.

description.zh: 國際通、市場、壺屋陶器街與波上宮，搭單軌就能走完。
description.en: Kokusai-dōri, the market, Tsuboya's pottery street and Naminoue Shrine, all by monorail.

description.zh: 首里城、玉陵、齋場御嶽和幾座城跡，認識琉球的歷史。
description.en: Shuri Castle, Tamaudun, Sēfa-utaki and the castle ruins of the old Ryūkyū kingdom.

description.zh: 美國村、真榮田岬、萬座毛，一路到古宇利大橋與美麗海。
description.en: American Village, Cape Maeda and Manzamo, up to the Kōri Bridge and Churaumi.

description.zh: 兼六園、21世紀美術館、近江町市場與茶屋街，再搭巴士到白川鄉。
description.en: Kenroku-en, the 21st Century Museum, Ōmichō Market and the teahouse districts, then a bus to Shirakawa-gō.

description.zh: 大通公園、電視塔、時計台和二條市場，晚上到薄野。
description.en: Ōdōri Park, the TV Tower, the Clock Tower and Nijō Market, then Susukino at night.

description.zh: 白色戀人、啤酒博物館、藻岩山夜景與跳台。
description.en: Shiroi Koibito Park, the beer museum, the night view from Mt Moiwa and the ski jump.

description.zh: 運河、堺町通的玻璃與音樂盒，從老車站走一圈。
description.en: The canal and the glass and music-box shops of Sakaimachi, a loop from the old station.

description.zh: 名古屋城、熱田神宮與大須，再看鐵道和豐田的博物館。
description.en: Nagoya Castle, Atsuta Shrine and Ōsu, plus the railway and Toyota museums.

description.zh: 港邊的水族館與樂高樂園，吉卜力公園和犬山城。
description.en: The port aquarium and Legoland, Ghibli Park and Inuyama Castle.

description.zh: 原爆圓頂館與和平紀念公園，再到廣島城和縮景園，晚上吃御好燒。
description.en: The Atomic Bomb Dome and Peace Park, Hiroshima Castle and Shukkei-en, then okonomiyaki.

description.zh: 海上鳥居與嚴島神社、彌山，再到吳的大和博物館與尾道。
description.en: The floating torii and Itsukushima Shrine, Mt Misen, then Kure's Yamato Museum and Onomichi.
